sources.title: Compositions and convex combinations of averaged nonexpansive operators
sources.authors: Combettes, P. L.; Yamada, I.
sources.verdict: Prop. 2.5 (eq. 2.8): heterogeneous composition constant phi(alpha_1..alpha_m), symmetric in the alpha_i, better than max-based constant (Remark 2.7); tight for m=2 only (via HRY20 Cor. 1); different functional and model. Closest analogue of H1-vs-fallback and of H2.

sources.title: Hierarchical singular value decomposition of tensors
sources.authors: Grasedyck, L.
sources.verdict: Lemma 3.10/Thm 3.11: root-sum-square of heterogeneous node-wise errors in any order (non-sharp, multiset-only dependence); Thm 3.18 uniform allocation eps/sqrt(2d-3). Single-tensor projections, no multilinear maps.
sources.threat_note: round-1 threat 1 for R-claims; 3 for heterogeneous claims H1/H2

sources.title: Tensor-train decomposition
sources.authors: Oseledets, I. V.
sources.verdict: TT-SVD: error <= sqrt(sum eps_k^2) with heterogeneous per-unfolding errors; per-core tolerance eps/sqrt(d-1). Theorem numbering not verified.

sources.title: Tensor Spaces and Numerical Tensor Calculus
sources.authors: Hackbusch, W.
sources.verdict: Thm 11.58 (as quoted in MiS preprint 29/2018 eq. 4.13): HT HOSVD truncation error <= sqrt(sum of node tails) <= sqrt(2d-3) best; heterogeneous, non-sharp.

sources.title: A new truncation strategy for the higher-order singular value decomposition
sources.authors: Vannieuwenhoven, N.; Vandebril, R.; Meerbergen, K.
sources.verdict: Thm 5.1 (preprint numbering): exact error expression of truncated orthogonal Tucker approximation valid for any permutation of the modes; order-independence of an exact identity (not a worst-case constant). POST_HOC inclusion from round-1 pool reading; not in het pool.

sources.title: Approximation by tree tensor networks in high dimensions: Sobolev and compositional functions
sources.authors: Bachmayr, M.; Nouy, A.; Schneider, R.
sources.verdict: Lemma 4.9 / Prop. 4.7: additive node-wise accumulation along trees of compositions with level-dependent weights C(B,s,level); heterogeneous, non-sharp, placement-dependent (contrast H2). Title verified on arXiv PDF.

sources.title: Error transportation in SVD-based tensor-train approximations
sources.authors: Zniyed, Y.; Boyer, R.
sources.verdict: Transport of local truncation errors through dimension trees; tree/data-dependent conditioning factors; sharp identity only for chains. PROVISIONAL (abstract only); MANUAL full text (HAL bot check not bypassed).

sources.title: Rank-adaptive time integration of tree tensor networks
sources.authors: Ceruti, G.; Lubich, C.; Sulz, D.
sources.verdict: Thm A.1: uniform vertex tolerance (root may differ), telescoping bound depending only on number of vertices; heterogeneous version not stated; non-sharp.

sources.title: Tight coefficients of averaged operators via scaled relative graph
sources.authors: Huang, X.; Ryu, E. K.; Yin, W.
sources.verdict: Thm 1: exact product of two different disks (Cartesian oval); Cor. 1: tight heterogeneous two-factor averagedness coefficient. Heterogeneity is disk radius, not angle cap; two factors; different functional.
sources.threat_note: L1 3 lowered to 2 at L3 adjudication

sources.title: Exact Minkowski products of N complex disks
sources.authors: Farouki, R. T.; Pottmann, H.
sources.verdict: Prop. 4.1: product of N disks with different radii (heuristic boundary); Sec. 5 equal-point powers give the all-caps-pi/2 special case of H3 (round-1 R7(a)). No capped arcs.

sources.title: Scaled relative graphs: nonexpansive operators via 2D Euclidean geometry
sources.authors: Ryu, E. K.; Hannah, R.; Yin, W.
sources.verdict: Thm 7: SRG of composition = Minkowski product of heterogeneous SRGs (angles add, lengths multiply); technique adjacent; no capped arcs, no tree constant.

sources.title: Products of orthogonal projections
sources.authors: Oikhberg, T.
sources.verdict: Lemma 2(a) (round-1 L3): planar chain of line projections with arbitrary successive angles acts as prod cos(theta_j) e^{i theta_j}; independent-angle planar witness known as a construction; extremality not stated.
sources.threat_note: round-1 threat 1 (R-claims); 2 for the H4 construction

sources.title: Complex disk products and Cartesian ovals
sources.authors: Bunger, F.; Rump, S. M.
sources.verdict: Exact complex disk products via Cartesian ovals (title/metadata only). READ before submission.

sources.title: What limits the simulation of quantum computers?
sources.authors: Zhou, Y.; Stoudenmire, E. M.; Waintal, X.
sources.verdict: Eq. (17): F(n) approx prod f_i, heterogeneous per-gate truncation fidelities, heuristic; no worst-case bound.

sources.title: Matrix product states represent ground states faithfully
sources.authors: Verstraete, F.; Cirac, J. I.
sources.verdict: Lemma 1: ||psi - psi_D||^2 <= 2 sum_alpha eps_alpha(D), heterogeneous per-bond discarded weights, additive, non-sharp.

sources.verdict: Lemma 4: angle hybrid argument adding heterogeneous per-step angles arcsin||Pi_y Psi_i||; technique analogue of heterogeneous angle subadditivity (unit vectors, unitary steps).
